title: Set CloudWatch Log Retention
scenario: Logs are retained forever and costing money. Set a 14-day retention policy.

focus.title: Complete the aws_cloudwatch_log_group resource
focus.todo: Add the arguments and nested blocks required for aws_cloudwatch_log_group.

hints.why: Observability resources turn an invisible system into something you can alert on. Metrics, logs and alarms belong with the infrastructure they monitor.
hints.what: Complete the marked region in `main.tf`. The work is inside `resource "aws_cloudwatch_log_group" "this"`. Add the arguments and nested blocks required for aws_cloudwatch_log_group. Use the visible constraints as the checklist for names, values and references before you run the tests.
hints.when: Add monitoring whenever a resource has a failure mode that an operator must notice quickly.
hints.how: Open `main.tf` and work only inside `resource "aws_cloudwatch_log_group" "this"`. Use this code shape: name; retention_in_days. Use the already-declared references instead of hardcoded values: `var.log_group_name`. Keep the block header and braces, indent nested blocks by two spaces, and add one argument or nested block at a time. Run the tests after each small change so the first failure points at the next name to fix.
